SwarmTalk

SwarmTalk is an open-source, low-cost, and plug-and-play solution for decentralized UAV-to-UAV communication. It leverages the 2.4GHz Wi-Fi spectrum and a connectionless protocol to enable UAVs to seamlessly exchange binary data through an ad-hoc network. The system integrates effortlessly with ROS 2, allowing UAVs to dynamically join or leave operations without centralized control or extensive pre-configuration. Source code is available on GitHub.

Features

  • Decentralized communication with no need for centralized infrastructure.
  • Ad-hoc networking for dynamic UAV participation.
  • Seamless ROS 2 integration for flexible UAV operations.
  • Low-cost implementation using widely available hardware like ESP32 modules.

System Architecture

The system architecture includes ROS 2 nodes running on the UAV’s onboard computer and an ESP32 module running the communication firmware. This ensures efficient and dynamic communication across UAVs, supporting flexible mission operations.

Submodules

Planning Module: Tools and algorithms for autonomous UAV path planning. Communication Firmware: ESP32 firmware enabling the communication capabilities of the system.
